statement.notes: The primary cash flow statement provides a single line item for 'Depreciation and amortization' under the operating activities section. This is the only value directly mapped to the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease right-of-use asset amortization, rental expense) but these are components already included in the consolidated 'Depreciation and amortization' total or are part of other operating adjustments. Therefore, only the explicit line item from the primary statement is extracted.
